title: ResilienceSnapshotView
description: Resilience claim consumed by <elohim-resilience-snapshot>. Collective-general: stewards of the content can be any collective kind (household, church, patron-circle, DAO, …) — any group that holds DHT-notarized REA commitments under the social-compute epic. Source of truth: computed projection. Operational Category C.

distributionState.description: unmeasured = content has never entered the distribution plane (no shard manifest) — every count below is a non-measurement, NOT a measured zero. measured = a shard manifest exists and the counts are real. Renderers MUST show a distinct 'not yet distributed' state for unmeasured, never a fake at-risk verdict. Diagnostic tell preserved: a measured content with regionless stewards puts steward counts in regionalDistribution.unknown, so unknown == 0 with all-zeros implies unmeasured.

stewardingCollectives.description: Distinct collectives (of any kind) with at least one peer holding this content.

commitmentBackedCollectives.description: Distinct collectives with an active REA commitment covering this content.

diversityScore.description: 0..1 — ratio of achieved distinct-collective placements to requested.

reciprocatingCollectives.description: Collectives that both steward this content AND are stewarded by the viewer's collective (mutual reciprocation). Optional; omitted when no viewer context is supplied.

stewardingCollectives.description: Collectives currently stewarding this content, with their kind so the UI can label per-kind ('household', 'church', 'patron-circle', etc.).

kind.description: Collective kind: 'household', 'church', 'patron-circle', 'dao', or any future collective kind declared in the collectives table.

intraHubPeers.description: Distinct agents/devices WITHIN this collective holding the content — the intra-hub resiliency lens. stewardingCollectives (top-level) is the inter-hub count; this is the intra count per entry. Folded from the holder-relation's retained per-agent dimension (2026-06-19-resilience-facings design).

onlinePeers.description: Live/known peer pair — honest denominators. live = peers with an active online|degraded PeerStatus across the stewarding collectives; known = stewarded nodes registered across those collectives. Renderers show 'live/known peers live' (e.g. '2/3'); '0/0' only when genuinely nothing is known.

feltStatus.description: Household-addressed felt projection of the resilience claim — names, not nines. Computed in household_resilience.rs::snapshot(). Honest by construction: floor-relative (reassurance is measured against the content's resilience floor, not a flat threshold) and unmeasured-aware (distributionState 'unmeasured' → reassurance 'not-yet-seen', never a fake verdict). The inverse of the operator debug Lens; consumed by <elohim-memory-safety>.

headline.description: Canonical content-neutral felt sentence — the single source of truth for the translation. The consuming component adds warm framing ('your memories', the album name); it never re-translates the state.

reassurance.description: Floor-relative felt state. not-yet-seen = unmeasured (never entered the distribution plane). protected = meets the floor with no active gap. watching = a holder lapsed but coverage survives, OR below the floor but still holding. needs-help = critically thin (<=1 household).

heldBy.description: The collectives currently holding this content, with display labels — names, not nines. Same shape as details.stewardingCollectives.

intraHubPeers.description: Distinct agents/devices WITHIN this collective holding the content — the intra-hub resiliency lens (same shape as details.stewardingCollectives).

floor.description: The resilience FLOOR this content is measured against — the content-relative denominator. Expresses 'held by M of the N homes this should live in'. See genesis/data/timeline/backlog/resilience-tier-content-declared-floor.md.

tier.description: Resilience tier (value-driven, owner-declarable): 'standard' (default) until the content declares its own value-tier (vault/keepsake/ephemeral/...). NOT derived from reach.

tierDeclared.description: false = the tier is a default, not the owner's declared intent (honesty marker — the surface must not imply the household chose this floor).

wantsHouseholds.description: Households this tier wants holding the content (the floor).

hasHouseholds.description: Households currently holding it (the achievement against the floor).

suggestedAction.description: One pro-social action offered when protection is short or unseen (e.g. 'Invite a household to help hold these'). Omitted when none needed.
